content: Phexroosinne Yohannisi Ayhuda Duulataso Shiiqo
Phexroosinne Yohannisi asaas haasayan dishin qeeseta
Halaqatinne Xoossa Keeththaa naagizayta halaqay qasseka Saduqaaweti isttako yida.
Histtidi Hawaareti asaa tamaarsizayssassinne Yesusa baggara beettida hayqqidayta denththaa gishshas sabbakizayssas keehi hanqettida.
Phexroosanne Yohannisa gadey qammishin oykkidi wonttana gakkanaas qasho keeththan ayssida.
Gido attiin qaalaa siyida asaappe dariza baggay ammanides; ammanida attuma asaa qooday gede ichchashu shii gakkanaas dhoqqu gides.
Wonteththa gallas istta halaqatinne cimati qasseka Muse wogaa tamaarsizayti Yerusalaamen shiiqida.
Istta qeeseta halaqa Haannaynne Qayafay, Yohannisi, Iskindiroosinne qeeseta halaqaso asay wuri heen beettida.
Isttika Phexroosanne Yohannisa ba giddon aaththi essidi, «Hayssa intte ooththizay aaza wolqqanee? Woykko oona sunththanee?» giidi oychchida.
He wode Phexroosi Xillo Ayanan kumidi, «Intteno dere halaqatoo! Dere cimatoo!
Intte hach ha toho sila addezas oosettida lo7o oosoy waani izi paxidaakko intte nuna oychchizaa gidikko,
intte kaqqiin Xoossi hayqoppe denththida Naazirete Yesus Kirstoosa sunththan izi paxidayssanne intte sinththan izi eqqidayssa intteka Isra7eele dere asay wuri hayssa erite.
Izikka intte keeththa hiillati leqqi aggida shuchchay gimbe keeththas gula
bolla bollara woththiza shuch gidides.
Atoteththi hara oonankka baa; saloppe garsa baggara nu asa nayti attana mala nuus imettiday hayssafe hara sunththi deenna» gides.
Ayhudata duulata asaykka Phexroosinne Yohannisi hessaththo xali haasayzayssa be7idi istti tamaarontta as gididayssa eridi malalettidanne istti kase Yesusara dizayta gididayssa akeekida.
He paxida addezi isttara eqqi dishin be7ida gishshas isttas hara ooththanaas gaasoykka dhaydes.
Hessa gishshas istta duulataappe kessana mala azazida. Hessafe qasseka shiiqettidi ba giddon zorettida.
Ba giddon, «Hayta asata wosttinoo? Yerusalaamen diza asay wuri istta kushen hanida gita malaataa erides. Hessa gishshas nu ha yo7oza asaa baleththanaas dandayokko.
Gido attiin hayssi yo7ozi dere giddon keehi aakkontta malanne hayti asati nam7anththo hayssa ha sunththaan hara oonaska yootontta mala isttas lo7eththi yootana» gida.
Istta xeygidinne mulekka Yesusa sunththan haasayontta malanne tamaarsontta mala azazida.
Phexroosinne Yohannisi qasse zaaridi, «Nuni Xoossafe bollara inttes azazettanaas bessizaakko ane intte Xoossa sinththan pirdite.
Nuni nu be7idayssanne nu siyidayssa haasayanaappe guye gookko» gida.
Qasseka istta bolla mandidi yeddida; gaasoykka hankko derey wuri hanida yo7oza gaason wurikka Xoos galatiza gishshas istta qaxxayanaas dandaybeettenna.
He gita malaataan paxida addezas layththay oyddu tammaafe bolla.
Phexroosinne Yohannisi qashoppe birshettidi ba asataakko simmidi qeeseta Halaqatinne Dere cimati istta gidayssa ubbaaka yootida.
Isttika hessa siyida mala ba qaala dhoqqu histtidi issife Xoossaako, «Wogga Godawu! Neni salonne sa7a, abbanne abba giddon dizayta wursa medhdhadasa.
Ne ashkaraa nu aawaa Dawite doonara Xillo Ayanan,
«Tumappe Herdoosinne Phanxoosa Philaxoosi Isra7eeletaranne hara dere asaara hanno katamayn ne doora tiyda geeshsha naaza Yesusa bolla yo7o qachchanaas shiiqettida.
Hayssanka ne wolqqaninne ne shenen kase ne qoppidayssa istti polida.
Godoo! Ha7ikka istta mandeza ne beya; nuni ne aylleti ne qaala babbontta kumeththa xalateththara yootana mala dandayssa.
Paththanaas ne kushe micca. Ne naa geeshshaza sunththan gita malaata ooththa» gida.
Istti woossidaappe guye istti dizasoy qaaxxides; wurikka Xillo Ayanan kumidi Xoossa qaala xalateththan yootida.
Ammanizayta Issifeteththa Duus
Ammanizayti wurikka issi wozinaninne issi qofan gaaggi deettes. Isttas dizay wuri issi bolla dees attiin baas dizaaz, «Hayssi taas buzo miishsha» gizaadey deenna.
Hawaaretikka Godaa Yesusa denththaa gita wolqqan markkateth oykkida; ubbaa bolla gita Xoossa kiyateththi dees.
Istta giddon metotanchchay issaadeyka deenna; gaasoykka gade gidiin, keeththe gidiin baas dizaa ubbaa bayzi bayzi shiishshida miish,
Hawaareta kushen woththidi issaades issaades izas koshshiza mala gisheettes.
Qophiroose geetettizason diza Yooseefe geetettizaadey issi Lewe bagga asi dees; izikka Hawaaretan, «Barnabaasa» geetetti summides. Hessas birsheththay, «Minththeththo naa» guussa.
Izikka ba gade bayzida miishshaa ehidi Hawaareta kushen woththides.

Gula: Gula gizayssa issi issi bagga gamoththo qaalan magala woykko yochcha shuch geettes.
